messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

My day out runs from 11:00 until 22:55. I can spend at most S$78. I definitely need to see Clarke Quay, Lau Pa Sat and Singapore Cable Car. Optionally, Universal Studios Singapore, Skyline Luge Sentosa and Garden Rhapsody. I want to be at Clarke Quay no earlier than 16:00 and done there by 19:30.

response: Planning a trip from 11:00 to 22:55 with a budget of S$78. I really need to hit up Singapore Cable Car, Lau Pa Sat, and Clarke Quay. For Clarke Quay, I need to be there no earlier than 16:00 and finished by 19:30. If there's extra time, I'd love to check out Universal Studios Singapore, Skyline Luge Sentosa, and Garden Rhapsody too.
